𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰 𝗔𝗱𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗿𝘆 𝗦𝘂𝗺𝗺𝗮𝗿𝘆 – 𝗦𝗿𝗶 𝗨𝗷𝗷𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗶 𝗠𝗮𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗸𝗮𝗹𝗶 𝗕𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹𝘂 𝗝𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗿𝗮 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟱.

𝐄𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬:

 13th July 2025 (00:00 hrs) to 15th July 2025 (03:00 hrs)
  Location: Ujjaini Mahankali Temple, Secunderabad

𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁 -

Heavy traffic congestion within 2 km radius of the temple.

Passengers traveling from Secunderabad Railway Station are advised to start early and use Platform 10 entry from Chilkalguda side due to congestion on Platform 1 side.

𝗥𝗼𝗮𝗱 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗲𝘀 -

Roads from Tobacco Bazar,      Hill Street, Adavaiah X Road, General Bazar to Mahankali Temple
Subash Road (Bata X Road to      Rocha Bazar)

𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰 𝗗𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 (𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁𝘀) -

𝗥𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗴𝘂𝗻𝗷 𝗫 𝗥𝗼𝗮𝗱𝘀: Traffic diverted via      Minister Road → Rasoolpura → CTO → SBI X Roads → YMCA → Sangeeth →      Gopalapuram to reach railway station.

𝗚𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶 𝗫 𝗥𝗼𝗮𝗱𝘀: Traffic from Bible House      diverted via Sajjanlal Street or Hill Street.

𝗣𝗮𝘁𝗻𝘆 𝗫 𝗥𝗼𝗮𝗱𝘀: Diversions towards      Paradise, Clock Tower, Minister Road, or Tankbund.

𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝗫 𝗥𝗼𝗮𝗱𝘀: Traffic from CTO diverted      via Sindhi Colony and Minister Road.

𝗔𝘃𝗼𝗶𝗱: Paradise, Patny, Begumpet      route to Secunderabad Station due to congestion.

𝗦𝘂𝗴𝗴𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗥𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗲𝘀 𝘁𝗼 𝗦𝗲𝗰𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗱 𝗥𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘄𝗮𝘆 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 -

Via Punjagutta → Khairatabad      → IMAX → Lower Tankbund → Musheerabad → Chilkalguda (Platform 10 side).

Avoid roads via Patny and Paradise

𝗣𝗮𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗼𝘁𝗲𝗲𝘀 -

𝗩𝗲𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗯𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗸 𝗮𝘁 𝗱𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗯𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗼𝗻 𝗿𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗮𝗿𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗮𝗹, 𝗶𝗻𝗰𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴:

Hari Hara Kala Bhavan.
Mahabub College.
Old Jail Khana (Station Road).
Islamia High School (Ghasmandi).
Adavaiah Memorial School (Ranigunj).
Nallagutta GHMC Ground, Wesley College, Swapnalok      Complex.
Taj Tri Star Lane, Belson Taj Lane, CMR Shopping Mall, and more.

𝗛𝗲𝗹𝗽 & 𝗨𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀 -

Traffic Helpline: 9010203626
Facebook: https://t.co/RMgFu4sqLB
Twitter: @HYDTP
